title: Settling from a voice or from being lifted
summary: Most babies settle when spoken to or picked up by about 2 months, CDC says.
body: Quieting after a voice, or after being lifted, is the behavior on the line. It is not a promise that tears stop on a clock. The same age page suggests a steady adult use soft talk, holding, rocking, or song, and says that eases stress and fears. This American leaflet is not a clinical exam. If the timing worries a caregiver, the page says to talk with the child's doctor rather than to apply a label.

sources.title: Milestones by 2 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports 'Calms down when spoken to or picked up' and the tip about talking softly, holding, rocking, or singing.
